headline: Browns-Buccaneers matchup Sunday is more than just Baker Mayfield facing his old team
summary: — Baker Mayfield has become the leader and face of the franchise the Cleveland Browns hoped for when they drafted him No. 1 overall in 2018.

headline: Seahawks Rule Out QB Sam Darnold For Week 2
summary: As expected, the Seahawks will be without their starting quarterback in Week 2. Head coach Mike Macdonald confirmed on Wednesday that Sam Darnold will miss Seattle’s upcoming game against the Cardinals. headline: Colts WR Keenan Allen Formally Charged With Two Misdemeanors
summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was arrested on misdemeanor charges of DWI and DWI endangering a person on Aug. 30. Allen has now been formally charged with operating a vehicle with an alcohol concentration equivalent of 0.15 or more and operating a vehicle while intoxicated, Nathan Brown of the Indianapolis Star reports. Both charges are […]

headline: Report: Keenan Allen's BAC was measured at 0.224 percent
summary: Colts receiver Keenan Allen faces an enhanced misdemeanor charge for DUI, because his blood-alcohol concentration (alcohol concentration equivalent, in Indiana parlance) exceeded 0.15 percent after he was arrested last month.

headline: Bears anticipate 'great challenge' vs. Brian Flores' Vikings defense
summary: "Coach [Ben Johnson] calls this 'mental war' when you go against versus him, and that's what it is," Bears QB Caleb Williams said of facing a Brian Flores-led defense, which Chicago will do Sunday against Minnesota.

headline: Falcons Undecided On Week 2 QB
